nodes.text: ⭕ Treatment: There is no specific targeted treatment for HMPV.  Treatment is conservative and involves symptom management with antipyretics, steroids, and decongestants. In severe cases, the patient may need to be admitted to the hospital for oxygen or respiratory support.
